name: Tiny Desk AI
tagline: Make a fictional concert video from consenting adults’ portraits
description: Tiny Desk AI is an independent browser-based photo-to-video maker for a fixed fictional AI-remade concert performance. Choose one lead portrait and up to four additional portraits of consenting adults. Unfilled roles remain fictional bandmates. The output is an approximately 18-second vertical 9:16 MP4, with supplied sound and a silent copy. Generation requires paid credits: 480p uses 10 credits and 720p uses 20, regardless of whether one or five people are selected. One-time packs start at $9.99 before applicable tax; there is no free personalised preview or free generation. Obtain consent for every likeness, label synthetic videos and check the music rights for the intended use. The service is independent of NPR, Charlie Wilson and the Gap Band.
